annotations.title: Draw a series from a core and R groups

description: Draw a structure–activity series: a core with R groups and each compound made by putting its substituents on, all in the same pose and numbered. `compounds` in the result gives each one’s SMILES, formula, molecular weight and InChIKey, for a table beside your data. Stereo on the core and the substituents is kept. A compound whose atoms do not add up, or that breaks a valence, is refused by name. Not for unrelated structures side by side (use draw or render_scheme) or for stereoisomers (use draw with stereoisomers).

compounds.description: One per compound: its id and a substituent for every R, e.g. [{"id": "1a", "R1": "OC", "R2": "H"}]. A substituent is a SMILES that attaches by its first atom (or at * if it has one), or "H".

additionalProperties.description: R1, R2 …: a substituent SMILES or "H".

core.description: The core as SMILES, each R group as [*:n] on one single bond, e.g. "c1ccc(cc1)[*:1]".

dpi.description: PNG resolution, 300 by default; 600 for print.

format.description: png (default; returned as an image), svg (returned as text), pdf or eps (returned as base64 in `data_base64`).

opaque.description: White background instead of transparent (SVG, PNG). Default false.

style.description: Journal style. acs = ACS Document 1996 (default), rsc = RSC, nature = Nature Reviews, slides = heavier lines for slides.
